sections.title: Applied Statistics for Behavioral & Decision Sciences
sections.description: This course is a basic primer for key concepts in statistics needed for anyone that wants to take additional classes in behavioral and decision sciences- or work in a relevant field. This course helps serve as a prerequisite for the MBDS Program.
